sources.snippet: Blender Domain Randomization for Sim2Real Aggressive visual domain randomization pipeline for rendering sim2real robot manipulation training data. Uses pre-animated Blender scenes from physics simulation and applies DR following best practices from MolmoBot (2026), Tremblay et al. (2018), and RoboTwin 2.0 (2025).
